name: Vitex (Chasteberry)
summary: Vitex (Vitex agnus-castus, chasteberry) is the most-studied herb for PMS and cyclic breast pain. A meta-analysis of 3 CONSORT-compliant RCTs (n=520) found 2.57x higher PMS remission vs placebo - but only with characterized extracts (Ze 440/BNO 1095); most retail products are not these extracts. A 2013 systematic review of 13 RCTs found 7 of 8 PMS trials positive.
description: Canonical vitex research entity for evidence and safety integration. Publication remains held until extract-specificity (Ze 440/BNO 1095 vs generic products) is explicit, PMS vs mastalgia vs hyperprolactinemia indications are separated, and prolactin-related safety notes have passed the site's review gates.
primary_effects_or_targets: prolactin modulation; dopaminergic activity; PMS symptom cluster
